shared_or_similar_visual_information: A straight boundary separating the shaded and unshaded parts of a coordinate plane. Compare the diagonal line between the gray and white regions in the left image with the horizontal line between the gray and white regions in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: Points on the descending boundary satisfy the non-strict inequality represented by the shading. Right image: The horizontal equality boundary is included in the shaded solution region.
Rationales: Each region has a solid boundary, so points satisfying equality belong to both depicted solution sets along their respective lines.
